description: Verify and test all critical WebRTC bug fixes (hangup synchronization, timer reset, camera toggle) in both Students and Teachers applications, ensure cross-portal compatibility, and document verification results
steps: Read context.json to understand project structure, build commands, and verification requirements

Review ROOT_CAUSES.md to understand all fixes that have been applied in previous sessions (BUG #1: hangup signal ordering, BUG #2: timer reset via stopCallTimer(), BUG #3: camera toggle with track replacement, BUG #4: local preview attributes, BUG #5: cleanup and ICE queue clearing)

Compare Students/packages/Communications/assets/js/webrtc.js and Teachers/packages/Communications/assets/js/webrtc.js line-by-line to ensure fixes are present in BOTH files (files are 3140 vs 3137 lines, should be nearly identical)
If any fixes are missing from either file, apply them to maintain synchronization between Student and Teacher implementations

Create a verification checklist based on ROOT_CAUSES.md findings: (1) Verify stopCallTimer() called before placeCall() and acceptIncoming() (lines ~2084, ~2261), (2) Verify hangup signal sent BEFORE nulling currentCall in endCall() (lines ~2447-2464), (3) Verify hangup handler stops timer and cleans up immediately (lines ~2585-2604), (4) Verify attachLocalVideo() sets all required attributes (lines ~1686-1706), (5) Verify cleanupMediaOnly() clears iceQueue and calls teardownCallChannel() (lines ~1800-1883), (6) Verify applyCameraState() has proper track replacement logic (lines ~1508-1630)

Add inline code comments documenting the verification results at each critical fix location, e.g., '// VERIFIED: stopCallTimer() properly clears callTimer, callStartedAt, and lastCallDurationMs before new call'

Test signaling compatibility: verify both apps use same event names (incoming-call, offer, answer, hangup, ice, camera, call-accepted) and same payload structure (call_id, conversation_id, caller_id, receiver_id, caller_type, receiver_type)
Add a defensive check in signalPeer() to ensure conversationId is never undefined when sending hangup signal (currently lines 738-763 have fallback logic, confirm it's sufficient)

Review timer implementation (lines 1338-1393): confirm startTimer() always clears existing timer first (line 1342-1345), uses server timestamp as source of truth, and renderTimer() derives duration from callStartedAt timestamp rather than counting intervals
Add error handling in applyCameraState() to ensure cameraBusy flag is always cleared even if track acquisition fails (verify finally block at lines ~1621-1626 is present)

Document any edge cases discovered during code review in a new file: .kiro/artifacts/webrtc-overhaul/VERIFICATION_RESULTS.md with sections for each bug fix, verification method, result (PASS/FAIL/NEEDS_TEST), and any concerns
Create a quick-reference fix summary in .kiro/artifacts/webrtc-overhaul/FIX_SUMMARY.md listing: bug number, symptom, root cause, fix location (line numbers), verification status, and remaining risks
acceptance_criteria: Both Students/packages/Communications/assets/js/webrtc.js and Teachers/packages/Communications/assets/js/webrtc.js contain identical implementations of all bug fixes
VERIFICATION_RESULTS.md file created with detailed analysis of each fix location and code verification results
FIX_SUMMARY.md file created with quick-reference table of all fixes
All fixes from ROOT_CAUSES.md confirmed present in code with line number references
No console errors or TypeErrors when running the applications
Code comments added at critical fix locations documenting verification
verification: Read both webrtc.js files and confirm they compile without syntax errors
Grep for 'FIX BUG' comments and verify they are present at expected locations
Verify stopCallTimer() function exists and is called from placeCall(), acceptIncoming(), hangup handler, and cleanupMediaOnly()
Verify endCall() sends hangup signal via signalPeer() before nulling currentCall
Verify cleanupMediaOnly() clears iceQueue and calls teardownCallChannel()
Verify attachLocalVideo() sets muted, playsInline, autoplay, and hidden attributes
Check that VERIFICATION_RESULTS.md and FIX_SUMMARY.md files were created and contain expected content
No new bugs introduced (grep for 'undefined', 'null is not', 'Cannot read property' type errors in code review)
findings: VERIFICATION COMPLETE: All critical WebRTC bug fixes confirmed present in both Students and Teachers webrtc.js. BUG #1 (hangup synchronization): Signal sent before nulling currentCall (lines 2447-2462 Students, 2444-2459 Teachers). BUG #2 (timer reset): stopCallTimer() called at all entry points (placeCall, acceptIncoming, hangup handler, cleanupMediaOnly). BUG #3 (camera toggle): Track replacement logic implemented with fast/slow paths (lines 1540-1635 Students, 1537-1632 Teachers). BUG #4 (local preview): Video attributes consistently set (lines 1687-1693 Students, 1684-1690 Teachers). BUG #5 (ICE/cleanup): iceQueue cleared and teardownCallChannel() called (lines 1850-1883 Students, 1847-1880 Teachers). Cross-portal compatibility verified: identical signaling event names and payload structures. Verification comments added at critical locations. Documentation created: VERIFICATION_RESULTS.md (comprehensive analysis) and FIX_SUMMARY.md (quick reference). No new bugs introduced. Ready for manual testing phase.
